note: Vendored, hand-checked crosswalk for tools/prices/sources/ni-ward.mjs. The LPS annual house price workbooks name each ward only by council and name (12 names occur in two councils); this maps each (lgd, ward) as the workbook spells it to the Ward 2014 code (N08…) that the OSNI Largescale Wards (2012) polygons and NISRA use, and to the District Electoral Area (DEA) the ward lies in, as the LPS DEA workbook spells it. Codes, labels and DEAs come from NISRA's "Lookup Table - Ward2014 to DEA2014 to LGD2014" (OGL); "name" is NISRA's official ward label, shown on the map. Built 2026-09-29 from the 2025 LPS workbooks and PROVEN against NISRA PxStat NIDHPSATWARD (coded, 2005-2024): joining the LPS rows by name through this file reproduces PxStat's median and sales count exactly for 450-462 of the 462 wards in each year 2005-2023, and for every ward in at least 18 of the 20 years (see proof); a wrong mapping would disagree in nearly every year. LPS has since revised 2024 as late sales were verified, so that year differs by a sale or two in 89 wards. Rows with a "check" needed a human look (spelling, apostrophes, shared names); each was confirmed by council, DEA and code. The source module refuses to build if any LPS row fails to match a row here, so a renamed ward stops the build instead of vanishing.
